primary_selected.title: Zinc extraction from cast-house dust using the chemolithotrophic microorganism Acidithiobacillus thiooxidans
primary_selected.version: 10-page journal PDF, online 8 July 2025, volume 222 October 2025. Crossref license start is not substituted for publication date.
primary_selected.locators: Methods 2.1-2.7; Results 3.1-3.5; Tables 1-3; Figures 1-11; conclusion and data statement.
primary_selected.inspection: All primary methods/results and relevant conclusions read; all 11 figures and three tables visually inspected.
primary_selected.license: CC BY-NC 4.0, printed in article; raw PDF and images remain outside Git.

supplement.inspection: Read all native DOCX XML paragraphs and both statistical tables, checked ZIP contents (11 parts; no embedded media/charts), and visually inspected the complete one-page LibreOffice PDF render.
supplement.rendering: LibreOffice headless with an isolated temporary profile, followed by PyMuPDF rendering. Cached DOCX captions are Table 4/Table 5; recalculated SEQ fields render Table 1/Table 2. Numeric cells match, so locators use first/second supplementary table and exact row labels.
supplement.contradiction: First table .42 vvm; Day 7; Zn = 75.22526 with SD 3.01688, duplicating its day-14 entry. Figure 6 and second-table pooled day 7 Zn 68.05669 disagree. No replacement subgroup mean or recomputed test assigned.
supplement.license: No separate supplement license observed; primary article has CC BY-NC 4.0. Original DOCX/render retained outside Git.

context_primary.title: Zinc removal from metallurgical dusts with iron- and sulfur-oxidizing bacteria
context_primary.version: Minerals Engineering 206 (2024)108535; online 19 December 2023. DOI/title checked in full primary PDF and indexed publisher metadata; live Crossref request returned 429.
context_primary.inspection: Full methods/results/conclusion text read; only pages 4/5 visually inspected, covering Table 1 and Figures 2-4. No assertion that every figure was visually reviewed.
context_primary.scope: Same feed characterization cited by 2025; actual cast-house origin, Fe-rich mineralogy and separate 0.5-M H2SO4 chemical assays. A. ferrooxidans DSM 583/CCM 4253 yields are not imported.
context_primary.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, printed in article; raw outside Git.
context_primary.limitation: Some 50-g/L,50-degree chemical-curve points exceed 100%; not imported or silently repaired. Distinct methods and assay histories are not matched controls or independent replication of 2025.

identifier_checks.result: Species Acidithiobacillus thiooxidans confirmed live. No experimental strain accession, collection origin or stock authentication reported in selected 2025 main/SI; identifiers from older papers are not transferred.

corrections_and_access.notice_search: No matching correction/retraction notice identified in the bounded exact-DOI/title first result sets. Main Crossref has no update-to and empty relation, which does not prove universal absence.
corrections_and_access.limits: Direct main publisher HTML 403; reference 9 Crossref 429. Publisher-CDN DOCX succeeded, while PDF/XLSX extension attempts 404; these attempts do not inventory every possible supplement. Initial sandbox DNS failures retained in acquisition log.
corrections_and_access.data_statement: The main paper states no data was used for the research described; this incongruous statement is not evidence that no experiments occurred. Inspected supplement supplies statistical summaries, not per-cycle raw inventories. No complete raw-data deposit identified within these inspected routes.

accepted.scope: One process-defined secondary resource and conditional laboratory culture-associated Zn mobilization; no inherited criticality, strain accession, isolated-product recovery, industrial biological deployment or native concentration observations.
